payload.summary: Completed and integrated wp-db-projection and wp-telemetry-context. Tasks 2.1-2.5 and 3.1-3.5 are committed independently, their package branches are synchronized with origin, and the verified changes are merged into the feature branch. PostgreSQL projections preserve direct-SQL negative coverage and stale-claim fencing; telemetry now enforces immutable context, export-time masking, byte ceilings, and the deterministic per-attempt observation budget.
completed_work: Tasks 2.1-2.5: added the additive Alembic projection, queue compatibility checks, typed attempt/process-health repositories, canonical-claim fences, retention behavior, and complete direct-SQL negative fixtures.
Tasks 3.1-3.5: added immutable OperationContext propagation, W3C helpers, safe cross-provider telemetry, masking canaries, byte bounds, and a reserved final-observation budget.

Package verification passed: database 9 unit plus 23 PostgreSQL integration tests; telemetry 89 focused tests; Ruff, mypy, strict OpenSpec, and whitespace checks passed. The integrated database unit tests passed; its live rerun requires PostgreSQL and package-level disposable-Neon evidence remains authoritative.

decisions.title: Fence attempt writes against the canonical queue claim
decisions.rationale: FOR UPDATE checks ensure a stale claim can record only bounded evidence on its own attempt and cannot overwrite a newer attempt or canonical operation state.

decisions.title: Reserve capacity for terminal telemetry
decisions.rationale: The deterministic 256-observation/16-MiB envelope reserves 64 observations and 4 MiB for final evidence while shedding optional successful detail first and exposing omission counters.

next_steps: Implement the next dependency-ready packages from work-packages.yaml without weakening direct-SQL negative fixtures or generated validator parity.
Carry the package JUnit evidence into integration validation and retain the mandatory six-hour GX-10 acceptance gate.
